timing_rationale: Lagging: the occupational mix moves only as workers change jobs over years, and the Budget Lab updates the index about six weeks after each month.
tracker_interpretation: Forty-five months after ChatGPT the occupational mix has moved slightly more than it had at the same age from the January 2021 baseline, a curve that began before AI. The index between recent and older graduates, which the Budget Lab described in 2025 as rarely leaving a range of 30 to 33, has read a little above it every month since March 2026; the Lab's September 2026 update still finds its measures flat, within historical ranges or on pre-AI trends.
why_it_matters: If AI were reshaping work, the mix of occupations would move faster than in prior technology transitions. The Budget Lab finds it moving at about the historical pace.
